title: 1. Structure
markdown:
### 1. Structure

$$
\text{Node}(\text{Value}+\text{Reference})\ \overset{\text{Linked}}{+}\ \text{Node}+\cdots=\text{Linked List}
$$

- **Singly**：单向 → next
- **Doubly**：双向 ↔ prev / next
- **Head / Tail**：首尾 Node，不随 Traversal 方向改变
